skills.name: Eternal Oath
skills.description: Grants the frontmost ally a shield based on a percentage of Idun's ATK and reduces damage taken for a duration. Prioritizes allies with Golden Apple.

upgrades.level2: Increases duration of shield and damage reduction.
upgrades.level4: Further increases shield scaling based on ATK.

skills.name: Fruit of Eternity
skills.description: If the Ultimate targets an ally with Golden Apple, grants additional ATK based on Idun's stats for a duration.

upgrades.level2: Also grants Crit Chance during the duration.

skills.name: Life Awakening
skills.description: Heals the weakest ally based on Idun's ATK and the target’s lost HP. Can additionally trigger once on allies with Golden Apple.

upgrades.level3: Increases healing based on missing HP.

skills.name: Divine Protection
skills.description: Upon near death, Idun summons a massive Golden Apple shield that converts max HP into sustain over time. Triggers once per battle.

upgrades.level3: Reduces damage taken during the effect.

relic.name: Divine Sharing (神性共享)
relic.description: At battle start, grants the nearest frontline ally Golden Apple, providing a percentage of Idun’s base stats (ATK, HP, Armor, M-RES). While the target is alive, Idun takes reduced damage.

upgrades.level3: Further reduces damage taken while Golden Apple target is alive.
